headline: SSR MINING SURGES 20%: Q1 EPS Triples to $1.15, Silver Realized Above $90/oz, Ends Quarter Debt-Free
snippet: SSR Mining (NASDAQ: SSRM) posted Q1 EPS of $1.15 — crushing the $0.87 consensus — on $581.8M revenue, generating $211M in free cash flow. Its Puna silver mine in Argentina delivered $120M in site-level FCF at realized silver prices above $90/oz. With a pending $1.5B Copler mine sale, SSR closed Q1 with zero debt and $1.1B in total liquidity.

headline: IVANHOE Q1: Kamoa-Kakula Smelts 71,417 Tonnes Copper at $2.58/lb C1 — Site Revenue Hits $862M
snippet: Ivanhoe Mines (TSX: IVN) reported Q1 copper-in-anode output of 71,417 tonnes at Kamoa-Kakula with a C1 cash cost of $2.58/lb — beating the $2.60–$3.00/lb guidance — and site EBITDA of $397M at a 46% margin. On-site smelter economics are widening margins; the mine is on track to ramp to 500,000+ tpa from 2028.

headline: PAN AMERICAN SILVER Q1: $488M Free Cash Flow, Record $1.8B Cash — Board Targets $1B in 2026 Returns
snippet: Pan American Silver (TSX: PAAS) delivered Q1 free cash flow of $488M, lifting cash and short-term investments to a record $1.8 billion. Net earnings reached $456M ($1.08/share) on $1.2B revenue. The board approved a new capital allocation framework targeting up to $1 billion in shareholder returns in 2026 through dividends and buybacks.

headline: HECLA GOES DEBT-FREE: Revenue Doubles to $411M, Record $265M EBITDA, $55M Exploration Budget Set
snippet: Hecla Mining (NYSE: HL) reported Q1 revenue from continuing operations of $411M — up 100% year-over-year — with record adjusted EBITDA of $265M and record free cash flow of $144M. After quarter-end, Hecla redeemed its remaining $63M in senior notes, becoming long-term debt-free for the first time in years. The company is investing a record $55M in exploration in 2026.

headline: ENERGY FUELS Q1 REVENUE DOUBLES to $35.8M — Uranium Sales and Rare Earth Pivot Backed by $957M Treasury
snippet: Energy Fuels (NYSE: UUUU) reported Q1 revenue of $35.8M — more than double the year-ago $16.9M — driven by 510,000 lbs of uranium sold. The company also announced a planned acquisition of Australian Strategic Materials, produced 99.9%-pure terbium oxide at pilot scale, and carries $957M in working capital to fund its uranium-plus-rare-earth dual mandate.

headline: Mineros Posts RECORD Q1: $291.8M Revenue and $154.1M EBITDA as Gold Prices Drive a 131% Profit Jump
snippet: Mineros S.A. (TSX: MSA) delivered the strongest quarter in its history, with Q1 2026 revenue of $291.8M and adjusted EBITDA of $154.1M — driven by 60,782 gold-equivalent ounces and higher realized prices. The Colombia-and-Nicaragua-based producer's profit surged 131% year-over-year, with management hosting a results call today, May 7.

headline: ALASKA GOES BIG: Tectonic Metals (TSX-V: TECT) Deploys Five Rigs for 40,000m Season Backed by C$100M Treasury
snippet: Tectonic Metals launched the largest drill campaign in company history at its Flat Gold Project in southwestern Alaska, deploying five rigs to execute a 40,000m program targeting expansion, maiden resource definition, and district-scale discovery. Backed by a ~C$100M treasury and a 100% drill-hole hit rate across 191 previous holes at Chicken Mountain, a maiden NI 43-101 resource is targeted for Q1 2027.

headline: NEW FOUND GOLD CONFIRMS DEPTH: 9.51 g/t Au over 19.85m at Queensway, New Hits Below Planned Open Pits
snippet: New Found Gold (TSX-V: NFG) reported 2025 infill results confirming AFZ Core continuity at the Queensway project in Newfoundland, with the best intercept at 9.51 g/t Au over 19.85m. Critically, drilling beneath the Phase 2 pit designs hit 9.15 g/t Au over 7.15m and 14.1 g/t Au over 2.40m — expanding resource potential outside the planned pits. Four rigs are active in 2026.

headline: K92 Mining Reiterates 2026 Guidance and Holds 50-Day MA — GoldSeek Maps the Mining Sector's Next Move
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Gold SWOT analysis highlights K92 Mining's reaffirmation of 2026 production guidance and technical resilience above its 50-day moving average, while mapping the broader sector setup for gold and silver miners. The report assesses bullish sector catalysts — record margins, institutional underweighting, and compressed multiples — against near-term risk factors including currency headwinds and cost pressures.
